title: 8a.nu Send Grade Goal Adherence by Style
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eighta:send
| stats avg(grade_index) as actual count as sessions by style
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*actual/18.0,1), goal_label="18"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average send grade index with a simple target for each style, showing where 8a.nu send grade is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by style shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence style values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of style values with average send grade index and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which style settings help you hit your target for 8a.nu send grade and which ones fall short.
